rationale: Primary evidence resolves the disagreement in favor of faithful equivalence. The paper itself crosses from scalar floating-point arithmetic to the matrix-vector backward-error interface in Lemma 2.1, and its proof of Lemma 3.1 begins from exactly the two stage certificates stored by the Lean execution record. The record preserves the fixed-right-hand-side dependence and ordered computation; it does not assume the aggregate perturbations or their bounds. The theorem constructs the same explicit DeltaAtilde and DeltaA, uses the exact Frobenius norm, gamma definition, cost b + r^(3/2), and mixed epsilon gamma_c beta term, and states both selected generic backward conclusions. Requiring this theorem itself to reconstruct the stage witnesses from scalar fl operations would collapse a legitimate source-level lemma boundary and is not necessary for statement faithfulness.
